text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Nikkei Shinshun Hai. 
Determined to break away from her 
half-baked self, Mejiro Palmer goes all 
out with her party-animal energy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd buzzes with unease. Mejiro 
Palmer declares that she'll get any fans 
who aren't hyped yet fully on board with 
her running, and steps up to the race.
